lines: Seat 1 chooses Beastbane: at the end, 1 point per monster tile cleared, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Shifting tile at (-2, 2) (yields 3).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 chooses Warden: at the end, 1 point per tile from your opening you still hold, beyond the first, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Shifting tile at (-2, 2) (yields 3).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
A tie for the Shifting tile at (-2, 2) (yields 3) at 3 mana: nobody gets it.
Seat 1 gets the Shifting tile at (-2, 2) (yields 3) for free.
Seat 2 gets the Wild tile at (2, -2) (yields 4) for free.
Seat 3 gets the Shifting tile at (2, 0) (yields 2) for free.
Bid 4 mana on the Shifting tile at (1, -2) (yields 3).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 4 and keep 5 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 4 mana on the Steady tile at (-2, 1) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 4 and keep 5 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 wins the Shifting tile at (1, -2) (yields 3) for 4 mana.
Seat 1 wins the Steady tile at (-2, 1) (yields 2) for 4 mana.
Seat 3 gets the Steady tile at (-1, -1) (yields 2) for free.
Bid 1 mana on the Wild tile at (0, -2) (yields 0).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 1 and keep 4 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 2 mana on the Wild tile at (-1, 1) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 3 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
A tie for the Wild tile at (-1, 1) (yields 2) at 2 mana: nobody gets it.
Seat 2 wins the Wild tile at (0, -2) (yields 0) for 1 mana.
Seat 1 gets the Wild tile at (-2, 0) (yields 2) for free.
Seat 3 gets the Wild tile at (-1, 1) (yields 2) for free.
The opening is over. The rounds begin.
Every trait stays secret until the end. Guess a rival's alongside your orders, once per rival.
Round 1 of 8 begins.
Seat 1 collects 7 mana.
Seat 2 collects 7 mana.
Seat 3 collects 6 mana.
Attune the Shifting tile at (-1, 2) (yields 2) for 4 mana, leaving 8. If a rival attunes it too, nobody gets it.
Build a Shrine on the Shifting tile at (1, -2) (yields 3) for 5 mana, leaving 6: the tile yields 1 more mana. It is worth 1 point at the end to whoever holds the tile.
Round 1.
Seat 1 attunes the Shifting tile at (-1, 2) (yields 2) for 4 mana.

Seat 3 banks 1 point (1 for land, 0 for mana), 1 in all.
